description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SystemCheckException' within the 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Exception' namespace, used for handling system check errors related to PHP PDO extensions during installation of OrangeHRM.

classes.name: SystemCheckException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, used to signal specific system check issues during the installation process of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: notEnabledPDOExtension
methods.description: Static method returning an instance of SystemCheckException with a message indicating the PDO extension is not enabled.

methods.name: notEnabledPDOMySQLDriver
methods.description: Static method returning an instance of SystemCheckException with a message indicating the pdo_mysql extension is not enabled.
